  description = 'After the devastating events of Infinity War, the remaining Avengers assemble once more to reverse Thanos''s actions and restore balance to the universe. Using Quantum Realm technology, they embark on a time heist through their own history to collect the Infinity Stones before Thanos can.',
  imageUrl = 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310419663027009739/SGHqXeh8PZJcCDnFiAMuFi/avengers-endgame-2019-featured-nDMH44Zx5CVEtDxJrz6xBv.webp',

  openingWeekendMillions = 357,

  rtAudienceScore = 90,
  verdict = 'hit',
  cardMarketContent = '## Endgame: The Crown Jewel of MCU Card Collecting

Avengers: Endgame (2019) is the most significant MCU film for card collectors. As the conclusion to the Infinity Saga, it features the final appearances of Robert Downey Jr. as Iron Man and Chris Evans as Captain America. These "last appearance" cards carry extraordinary premium.

### Key Sets

The **2019 Upper Deck Avengers: Endgame** set is the most sought-after MCU card set ever produced. Final appearance autographs from RDJ and Chris Evans are the holy grails of MCU card collecting.

### Market Trends

Robert Downey Jr.''s final Iron Man autograph cards are the most valuable cards in the entire MCU hobby. Chris Evans''s final Captain America cards are close behind. The emotional weight of these being farewell performances drives prices to extraordinary levels. "I Am Iron Man" and "Avengers Assemble" themed cards are the most iconic.',
  keyCards = '- **Robert Downey Jr. Final Iron Man Auto** — Holy grail of MCU cards ($15,000+)
- **Chris Evans Final Captain America Auto** — "Avengers Assemble" era ($10,000+)
- **"I Am Iron Man" Snap Moment Card** — Most iconic MCU moment
- **"Avengers Assemble" Portal Scene Card** — Greatest MCU battle
- **Scarlett Johansson Final Black Widow Auto** — Sacrifice scene ($5,000+)
- **Josh Brolin Endgame Thanos Auto** — Final battle villain ($3,500+)',
  content = '## Whatever It Takes

Avengers: Endgame is the most ambitious and emotionally devastating film in superhero history. The Russo Brothers crafted a three-hour epic that serves as both a thrilling time-travel adventure and a love letter to 11 years of MCU storytelling. It became the highest-grossing film of all time (at the time) and delivered two of cinema''s most iconic moments: "I am Iron Man" and "Avengers... assemble."

## The Legacy

- **Highest-Grossing Film Ever** — Held the all-time box office record at $2.799 billion
- **"I Am Iron Man"** — Tony Stark''s sacrifice is the most emotional moment in superhero cinema
- **"Avengers... Assemble"** — The portal scene is the greatest crowd moment in movie history
- **Captain America Lifts Mjolnir** — The most cheered moment in MCU history
- **Farewell to the Original Six** — Iron Man dies, Cap retires, Black Widow sacrifices herself

## Fun Facts

- The "Avengers Assemble" portal scene took over a year of VFX work with 2,500+ shots
- Robert Downey Jr.''s "I am Iron Man" line was added during reshoots — the original ending was different
- Chris Evans''s reaction to lifting Mjolnir was genuine — he was told to "look surprised"
- The film''s opening weekend of $357M remains the all-time record
- The entire cast was brought together for the funeral scene, which required massive scheduling coordination

## Viewing Context

Avengers: Endgame is the **twenty-second MCU film** and the tenth entry in Phase 3. It is the conclusion of the Infinity Saga and requires viewing virtually every previous MCU film to fully appreciate. The time heist revisits moments from The Avengers, Thor: The Dark World, and Guardians of the Galaxy.',
  metaDescription = 'Avengers: Endgame (2019) — $2.8B all-time box office record, Iron Man''s sacrifice, and why Endgame cards are the holy grail of MCU collecting.',
  keywords = 'Avengers Endgame, MCU Phase 3, Iron Man death, Captain America, Thanos, I Am Iron Man, Avengers Assemble, trading cards, Marvel cards, box office record',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Avengers Endgame cards autograph',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is Avengers: Endgame on Disney+?","answer":"Yes, Avengers: Endgame (2019) is available on Disney+. It is the conclusion of the Infinity Saga and was the highest-grossing film of all time."},{"question":"How much did Endgame make?","answer":"Avengers: Endgame grossed $2.799 billion worldwide against a $356 million budget, earning $357 million opening weekend — both all-time records at the time."},{"question":"Who dies in Endgame?","answer":"Tony Stark / Iron Man sacrifices himself by using the Infinity Stones to snap Thanos and his army out of existence. Black Widow sacrifices herself on Vormir to obtain the Soul Stone. Captain America retires by living out his life in the past with Peggy Carter."},{"question":"What Endgame cards are most valuable?","answer":"Robert Downey Jr. final Iron Man autos ($15,000+) are the holy grail of MCU cards. Chris Evans final Captain America autos ($10,000+) and Scarlett Johansson final Black Widow autos ($5,000+) are also premium due to being farewell performances."},{"question":"Why is Endgame considered the greatest superhero film?","answer":"Endgame is the culmination of 22 films over 11 years — the most ambitious storytelling achievement in cinema history. It delivers iconic moments (I Am Iron Man, Avengers Assemble, Cap lifting Mjolnir) while providing emotional closure for beloved characters."}]',
  status = 'published',
  updatedAt = NOW()
WHERE slug = 'avengers-endgame-2019'
